summary.text: Victoria Garcia Wilburn is a Democratic state representative who represents Indiana House District 32, has served since 2022, and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Victoria Garcia Wilburn earned a bachelor's degree in occupational therapy from Boston University and a master's degree (2012) and doctorate (2014) in health science from the University of Indianapolis.

Her career experience includes working as a professor with the IUPUI School of Health & Human Sciences, and she has served on the boards of Hope Academy Recovery High School, Reach for Youth, Inc., and the American Occupational Therapy Association.
Garcia Wilburn assumed office on November 9, 2022, succeeding Tony Cook, and advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026.
In the November 3, 2026 general election she faces Republican Paul Nix.
For 2025-2026, she was assigned to the Employment, Labor and Pensions, House Judiciary, and Public Health committees.
